description: District budget allocation, utilisation, lapsed funds and revenue collections

empty.title: No budget data yet for this district.
empty.body: We add allocations and spending as PFMS and the state treasury publish them.

explainer: Out of every ₹100 given to {district} in FY {year}, about ₹{pct} was spent. The rest is still unspent or has lapsed.
explainerAllocOnly: {district} was given {amount} in FY {year}. How much of it was spent is not published yet.
explainerTap: Tap a department to see where its money went.
pictogram: About {n} of every 10 coins given were spent.

share.title: How each ₹100 is shared, FY {year}
share.units: Share of the total budget given to each sector
share.simple: {sector} gets the biggest share: about ₹{n} of every ₹100.
share.other: {n, plural, one {# other sector} other {# other sectors}}

sectors.title: Where the money went, FY {year}
sectors.units: Crore rupees per sector. Grey is what was given, colour is what was spent.
sectors.simple: The biggest share went to {sector}: {given} given, {spent} spent.

depts.title: Departments and their money
depts.showAria: Show all departments or only those with lapsed money
depts.empty: No department allocations published for this district yet.

sheet.story: {dept} was given {given} in FY {year} and spent {spent}.
sheet.storyNoSpend: {dept} was given {given} in FY {year}. Spending is not published yet.

revenue.title: Revenue collected each month
revenue.units: Lakh rupees. Colour is what was collected, grey is the target.
